scope: Standard Pandemic 2015 seven-role core only; no Legacy, expansion, or puzzle mechanics.

checked_claims.assessment: All four cures win immediately without eradication; eighth outbreak, required cube shortage, or inability to draw two Player cards loses. Detailed draw rule correctly avoids premature loss merely from an empty deck.
All component quantities and Player-card breakdown match.
Atlanta station/pawns, unused roles/pawns removed, outbreak zero, vial markers near indicators, leftmost infection-rate two.
4/3/2 starting cards for 2/3/4 players after Epidemics removed; highest held City population starts. Values visually checked because original extraction omits them.
4/5/6 Epidemics; face-down piles as equal as possible; shuffle one Epidemic per pile; smaller piles on bottom; unused Epidemics removed.
Nine cities: three with three cubes, three with two, three with one (18 total); nine cards to Infection Discard; rest form deck; setup Quarantine exception included.
Up to four repeatable actions; draw two together, resolve Epidemics then hand limit, infect cities; next player to left; active player decides after advice.

White-line drive; destination City card Direct Flight; departure City card Charter Flight; station-to-station Shuttle; wraparound connections including Sydney/Los Angeles. Direct Flight visually checked against extraction gap.
Current-city card to Player Discard; station from supply or relocated if six built; extras set aside in setup.
One selected-color cube returned to supply, or all selected-color cubes if cured; separate colors require separate actions; Medic exception included.
Same city and matching city card, give or take by agreement; immediate receiving-player hand limit; Researcher direction-specific exception on either player turn.

Five same-color City cards discarded at any station, four for Scientist; move marker to indicator; existing cubes and future placements persist until eradication; no cubes when cured or last cured cube removal eradicates; uncured zero does not.
Draw top two Player cards together; fewer than two loses without reshuffling; seven-card limit after Epidemics, immediate on other receipts; Role/Reference excluded.

Increase one space, draw bottom Infection card, add three if empty or fill to three then outbreak if occupied unless eradicated/protected, card to Infection Discard, shuffle only discard atop deck; Epidemic removed without replacement.

Each fully resolved in sequence; Events between; first Intensify empties discard, making second Epidemic card the lone card atop deck, subject to Events/eradication/protection before subsequent outbreak.
Track 2/2/2/3/3/4/4 visually verified. Draw rate cards from top one at a time; matching-color cube unless eradicated/protected; outbreak rather than fourth; cards to Infection Discard.

Marker for every outbreak; connected-city placement and subsequent chain outbreaks; skip cities already outbreaked for current Infection card; three cubes of each color possible; eighth outbreak immediately loses.
Any player, no action, player decides; no Event between drawing/resolving a card; normally discard to Player Discard, with Planner stored-Event exception.

checked_claims.assessment: Any pawn with permission; skip next normal Infect Cities step rather than Epidemic Infect; remove one Infection discard from game, permitted between Infect and Intensify.
Printed core card adds one research station to any city without City card. Global six-station constraint appears elsewhere in summary. Only assigned core card reproduction considered.
source_refs: official-event-puzzle.pdf p.2 Government Grant card only

checked_claims.assessment: Printed matching component says draw, inspect, rearrange top six Infection cards and return on top; publisher image corroborates title/artwork/visible text.
Action takes any discarded Event onto role; one stored, not hand; stored Event removed when played.
Both movement options, consent, action cost, movement only, own-hand flight costs with moved-pawn departure card for Charter, and no Operations Expert special move.
Treat all of one color; automatically remove cured cubes by entering or being present, including other-turn Dispatcher/Airlift moves; prevents cured-color placements/outbreaks only in own city.
Action builds without using City card; once per turn action discards any City card for station-to-any-city movement.
Prevents all-color placements and outbreaks in own/connected cities, excluding setup placements.
Researcher exception only gives from Researcher hand on either player turn; Scientist four same-color City cards to cure.
Introductory open hands; Standard/Heroic private by default with experienced-group open option; both discard piles freely examinable.

important_omissions_assessment: No important gameplay omission identified within the standard core scope. Timing, costs, component destinations, cure/eradication, role exceptions, all five core Events, and terminal conditions are covered.

source_adequacy.assessment: Adequate for the rules verdict. Complete authoritative extracted/pandemic-rules.txt was read. Differences in matching-extraction.txt were reviewed, and all eight matching rulebook page images were visually inspected, including text-extraction gaps. Supplemental component images supply two core Event effects not fully reproduced in the booklet.
limitations: Forecast full text is legible in a third-party-hosted photograph of the printed publisher component; the publisher-hosted image corroborates matching identity but partly obscures the effect. The seller is not treated as a rules author.
Government Grant support uses only the core card reproduced on page 2 of the official puzzle PDF; other cards and puzzle/expansion mechanics were excluded.
Nonmechanical website verification labels/dates, play-time metadata and hosting provenance beyond the supplied provenance records were not independently certified.
image_only_checks: Forecast printed effect and publisher-art corroboration
